feedback.title: Category-wise Customer Feedback Summary (Based on 2441 respondents)
rows: Product Availability & Assortment
Strongest concern; customers frequently reported product shortages, limited assortment, and missing regular/desired items.
Outlet Space & Environment
Concerns around small/congested outlets, AC, cleanliness, heat, facilities and overall shopping environment.
Fresh/Fish/Meat/Produce
Demand for regular fish, meat, vegetables, fruits and other fresh products, with availability and freshness concerns.
Quality & Expiry
Customers highlighted product quality, branded-product availability, freshness, damaged/expired products and quality consistency.
Service & Staff
Need for more staff, better customer assistance, staff training, product knowledge and more helpful behavior.
Checkout & Payment
Billing delays, insufficient counters, payment/POS/server issues and long queues were recurring concerns.
Promotion & Discount
Customers requested more discounts, better offer communication and sufficient stock of promotional products.
Price & Value
Customers frequently perceived selected products as more expensive than nearby markets/grocery stores.
Bag & Carrying Convenience
Requests for free/better bags, stronger bags, baskets and trolleys were observed.
Membership & Points
Issues related to lost points, card problems, point addition and membership-system reliability.
Delivery / Online / App
Feedback mainly covered delivery delays, online offer visibility and app-related expectations.
